include $(THEOS)/makefiles/common.mk

TWEAK_NAME = TapLock
TapLock_FILES = Shared/Preferences.swift Sources/AppAction.swift Sources/ControlCenterAction.swift Sources/NotificationCenterAction.swift Sources/ScreenshotAction.swift Sources/AppSwitcherAction.swift Sources/MediaPlayPauseAction.swift Sources/PrivateAPI.swift Sources/LockAction.swift Sources/HomeDoubleTap.swift Sources/NativeHook.swift Sources/Bootstrap.swift
TapLock_FRAMEWORKS = Foundation UIKit
TapLock_LIBRARIES = substrate

Makefile.after:
include $(THEOS)/makefiles/common.mk

TWEAK_NAME = TapLock
TapLock_FILES = Shared/Preferences.swift Sources/AppAction.swift Sources/ControlCenterAction.swift Sources/NotificationCenterAction.swift Sources/ScreenshotAction.swift Sources/AppSwitcherAction.swift Sources/MediaPlayPauseAction.swift Sources/FlashlightAction.swift Sources/PrivateAPI.swift Sources/LockAction.swift Sources/HomeDoubleTap.swift Sources/NativeHook.swift Sources/Bootstrap.swift
TapLock_FRAMEWORKS = Foundation UIKit
TapLock_LIBRARIES = substrate
TapLock_SWIFT_VERSION = 5

Preferences/SettingsController.swift.after:
case "playPause": return .playPause
            case "previousTrack": return .previousTrack
            case "nextTrack": return .nextTrack
            case "flashlight": return .flashlight
            default: return nil
            }
        }

Shared/Preferences.swift.before:
case playPause
        case previousTrack
        case nextTrack
        case unavailable
    }
    static let actionKey = "DoubleTapAction"
Shared/Preferences.swift.after:
case playPause
        case previousTrack
        case nextTrack
        case flashlight
        case unavailable
    }
    static let actionKey = "DoubleTapAction"

Shared/Preferences.swift.before:
record = ["kind": "previousTrack"]
        case .nextTrack:
            record = ["kind": "nextTrack"]
        case .openApp(let identifier):
            guard validBundleIdentifier(identifier) else { return false }
            record = ["kind": "openApp", "bundleIdentifier": identifier]
Shared/Preferences.swift.after:
record = ["kind": "previousTrack"]
        case .nextTrack:
            record = ["kind": "nextTrack"]
        case .flashlight:
            record = ["kind": "flashlight"]
        case .openApp(let identifier):
            guard validBundleIdentifier(identifier) else { return false }
            record = ["kind": "openApp", "bundleIdentifier": identifier]

Sources/HomeDoubleTap.swift.after:
MediaPlayPauseAction.previousTrack()
        case .nextTrack:
            MediaPlayPauseAction.nextTrack()
        case .flashlight:
            FlashlightAction.toggle()
        case .unavailable:
            break
        }
